Four-lane Welford/cascade reduction design derived from PyTorch CPU
aten/src/ATen/native/cpu/moments_utils.h, used by the frozen PyTorch 2.14 CPU
reference. The CUDA scheduling and explicit rounding implementation are local.
Source: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/aten/src/ATen/native/cpu/moments_utils.h
